children: Emergent received a $24 million BARDA contract modification to supply additional doses of CYFENDUS for anthrax preparedness.
BARDA issued Modification No. 21 under the AV7909 contract on Aug 18, 2026, valued at $24 million to procure CYFENDUS.
Modification relates to Emergent’s ongoing AV7909 development and procurement contract first effective Sept 30, 2016.
Press release announcing the contract modification was issued Sept 1, 2026 and furnished as Exhibit 99.1.
CYFENDUS is FDA-approved (July 2023) as a two-dose anthrax PEP vaccine for ages 18–65 when given with antibacterial drugs.
